verdict_text: YES. The merge is computed correctly: scale is read from the config as alpha over r (2), `B @ A` is formed in float32 from the float32 adapter factors, added to the upcast base weight, and cast back to the base dtype, with the transpose applied only when `fan_in_fan_out` is true (it is false here). All four required checks are asserted on the in-memory state dict before any write, so a violation aborts before output exists, and the output is written under `out/T5` with the 512 MiB limit passed to the sharded writer. The one thing not visible in the artifact is the imported `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors` helper, so the index file, header-excluded size accounting, and lone placement of the two oversized embedding tensors rest on that helper behaving as its name and arguments indicate.
